candidate_grammar.boundary: Every finite source-bound concentration/rate census for one registered reactant with exact positive concentration and rate supports and complete condition, method, uncertainty and row provenance.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of reactant, intervention, response, condition, completeness, relation, prediction and extension forms.

excluded_inputs: no numerical zero; absence is structural EmptyOne
no negative, irrational, imaginary, logarithmic, floating, signed or continuum SFT proof value
no imported mass-action or power law, conventional reaction order, fitted exponent/coefficient or continuum derivative
no interpolation, regression, averaging, favorable-row selection or target-derived correction
no target content before the complete identity and prediction seal
intended_certificate: Complete 256-form census, one survivor, independent exact-table reconstruction, depth-independent append and complete post-seal nine-row primary measurement vector.
statement: Chemical concentration dependence is the complete source-ordered relation between one held reactant's exact positive concentration support and exact positive elementary-transition rate response, retaining every condition, method, uncertainty and unfavorable row; no exponent is fitted.
title: Exact condition-bound concentration-dependence relation
